faqs.question: What is SNA / NEN 4400-1 certification and why does it protect hirers?
faqs.answer: MACEE is certified under NEN 4400-1 by the Stichting Normering Arbeid (SNA). This certification verifies that our payroll administration, payroll tax payments, and VAT remittances comply fully with Dutch legislation. Commissioning clients who hire through an SNA-certified partner are strictly shielded from chain liability (inlenersaansprakelijkheid).

faqs.question: How does MACEE help international specialists with the 30% tax facility?
faqs.answer: The Dutch 30% facility enables qualifying incoming international specialists recruited from abroad to receive 30% of their gross salary tax-free. As an IND Recognised Sponsor, MACEE prepares and submits the complete fiscal application to the Dutch Tax Office (Belastingdienst) and structures compliant payroll.

faqs.question: How do you prevent false self-employment (schijnzelfstandigheid) under the Wet DBA?
faqs.answer: We rigorously audit all ZZP assignments using standardized model agreements and role assessments. Where an assignment involves authoritative direction or integration into organizational hierarchy, we transition the professional to our compliant Secondment or Payroll model to prevent retroactive tax penalties.
